2609.39933.title: ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible
2609.39933.paper_summary: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.
2609.39933.paper_summary_zh: 在設計機器學習模型時，理想的特性往往存在緊張關係：改善一種行為可能會損害另一種行為，因此任務的進展可能依賴於減輕這種衝突。基於LLM的AutoResearch系統，通過迭代編輯模型代碼並根據標量任務性能反饋保留編輯，基本上忽略了這種權衡。我們發現，標量反饋支持在搜索早期的廣泛探索，但它並未揭示編輯如何影響競爭行為。在匹配預算的實驗中，隨著任務增益減少，引入競爭行為反饋會增加改善兩種行為的提案比例，並在超越僅標量的平臺上持續進展。獲得特定模型的這種反饋需要識別其競爭行為並設計探針來測量它們。為了使競爭行為反饋可操作，我們引入了ConflictGuide。其可重用的ConflictGuide-Skill結合了基於文獻的分類法和模型特定的證據，以識別競爭行為並指定探針，供代碼代理作為指標實施。進化分為兩個階段：第一階段使用任務反饋進行探索；第二階段使用探針反饋來引導提案朝向衝突緩解，並僅在探針指示有足夠緩解時保留邊際增益編輯。在五個不同的模型系列中，ConflictGuide相對於僅使用標量的AutoResearch，將任務和衝突相關錯誤分別降低了高達28%和14%，並且增益擴展到其他代碼代理。
